children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retest a resistance at 4,622 ringgit per metric ton, driven by wave c.
The bounce from 4,491 ringgit may consist of three waves. So far, only folded. The third wave, wave c, could have just started, travelling toward the peak of wave a around 4,622 ringgit.
Support is at 4,533 ringgit, a break below which may cause a fall into the 4,478-4,499 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the market failed to overcome the 4,623 ringgit barrier on its first attempt.
The current bounce is against the downtrend from 5,050 ringgit. A retracement analysis suggests a target zone of 4,705-4,771 ringgit.
Based on this reading, the contract may retest the resistance at 4,623 ringgit.
